type NestedValue<T, K extends keyof T> =
  T[K] extends {value: {text: string}} ? T[K]['value']['text'] : never;
type Selected<V, K extends keyof V, T, P extends keyof T> =
  T[P] extends {selected: keyof V[K]} ? V[K][T[P]['selected']] : never;
type Three<T, K extends keyof T> =
  T[K] extends {a: {b: {c: string}}} ? T[K]['a']['b']['c'] : never;
type ArrayItem<T, K extends keyof T> =
  T[K] extends {value: {text: string}[]} ? T[K]['value'][number]['text'] : never;
type Optional<T, K extends keyof T> =
  T[K] extends {value: {text: string} | undefined} ? NonNullable<T[K]['value']>['text'] : never;
type Branch<N, T, K extends keyof T> =
  T[K] extends {value: {text: string}} ? (N extends true ? T[K]['value'] : {text: string})['text'] : never;
const value: NestedValue<{a: {value: {text: string}}}, 'a'> = 'ok';
const selected: Selected<{a: {name: string}}, 'a', {p: {selected: 'name'}}, 'p'> = 'selected';
console.log(value, selected);
